text:
maya: FYI I opened PR #452 to revise the ZephyrH-13B model card — clarifying token limits, adding quantization compatibility notes, and updating SDK snippets (py/js). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452

 tom: we should avoid saying 'max tokens' as a universal hard limit. Hosted is typically 2048; Dedicated can be configured up to 4096. Recommend adding explicit fields like 'recommended_hosted_limit' and 'max_dedicated_limit' in the limits table.

 eva: benchmarks question — did anyone rerun throughput after the kernel toggles? The PR shows ~32ms/token p50; my run with batch=4 shows ~29ms. Artifact: https://artifacts.redwood-infra/bench/zephyrh-13b/2048

 jonathan: python snippet bug: SDK expects 'enable_streaming' (not 'stream'). Also we should make clear the separation of 'input_tokens' vs 'max_generation_tokens' to avoid confusion.

 ryan: link-checker flagged docs/ops/quantization.md#quantization-profiles — that anchor moved in the ops doc.

 ci-bot: docs/lint ❌ link-check failed in models/cards/zephyrh-13b.md -> docs/ops/quantization.md#quantization-profiles (404). See job: https://ci.redwood-infra/jobs/98321

 maya: I'll update the language to use 'recommended_hosted_limit' and 'max_dedicated_limit', split the token fields, and fix snippets ('stream' -> 'enable_streaming'). Also updating the quantization anchor to docs/ops/quantization.md#profiles.

 maya: updated python snippet:
 ```python
 from redwood import RedwoodClient
 client = RedwoodClient(api_key='$REDWOOD_KEY')
 resp = client.generate(
     model='zephyrh-13b',
     input_tokens=512,
     max_generation_tokens=512,
     enable_streaming=True,
     quantization_profile='q4_0_compat'
 )
 for chunk in resp.stream():
     print(chunk.text, end='')
 ```

 maya: updated js snippet:
 ```js
 import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
 const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
 const resp = await client.generate({
   model: 'zephyrh-13b',
   input_tokens: 512,
   max_generation_tokens: 512,
   enable_streaming: true,
   quantization_profile: 'q4_0_compat'
 });
 for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) {
   process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
 }
 ```

 tom: +1 on wording and limits table change.

 eva: please annotate the benchmark table with the batch size (batch=4) and the kernel flags used — helps reproducibility.

 ryan: re-run CI after the anchor fix shows ✅. I added a note in the PR about kernel flags that may influence numbers.

 jonathan: small snippet nit: add a comment explaining that 'q4_0_compat' indicates a profile compatible with hosted runtime fallback behavior.

 maya: added migration note: 'SDK v2 renames "stream" -> "enable_streaming". Update call sites and CI fixtures. See https://docs.redwood.com/sdk/migration-v1-to-v2'.

 maya: plan is to merge after final thumbs-up. Shipping in the docs patch this afternoon. Ping @tom @eva @jonathan @ryan for final sign-off :eyes:

 tom: :thumbsup:

 eva: :+1:

 jonathan: looks good to me

 ryan: merging when green 🚀
